input.prompt: Original hand-drawn adult animated science-fiction illustration, 2D cel animation look. Confident dark ink contours with varied expressive line weight; hard-edged cel shading in two flat tone steps; deliberately drawn one-point perspective down a long room; cinematic ultra-wide banner composition, 3:1. Scene: a personal signal room at night, eccentric but understandable electronics — a wall of small monitors and toggle switches, a reel-to-reel tape machine, a ham radio rig, a leaning stack of vinyl records, a coffee mug, a guitar propped in the corner, coiled cables, a small synthesizer, a framed picture of a tiny robot. One clear orange signal path runs as a drawn cable from a microphone at the left, loops through the equipment and exits toward a big round window at the right. Outside the window: an impossible space — a ringed planet, a second smaller planet with a visible city light line, and a distant space station shaped like an old radio tower. The left third of the image is deliberately calm and uncluttered so a profile picture can sit over it; the busy detail sits in the middle and right. Palette: deep ink navy and graphite, warm off-white walls, purposeful burnt orange on the signal cable and a few knobs, one restrained cyan screen and one acid-green power lamp. Small visual humour: a small round robot cat asleep on the tape machine. Entirely illustrated by hand; no photograph, no 3D render, no glossy plastic, no gradients, no glow haze, no text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks.
